def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==8]
    r0=min(r for r,_ in cs); r1=max(r for r,_ in cs); c0=min(c for _,c in cs); c1=max(c for _,c in cs)
    mks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=0 and g[r][c]!=8]
    mr0=min(r for r,_,_ in mks); mc0=min(c for _,c,_ in mks)
    hm=max(r for r,_,_ in mks)-mr0+1; wm=max(c for _,c,_ in mks)-mc0+1
    fg=[[g[mr0+i][mc0+j] for j in range(wm)] for i in range(hm)]
    # anti-diagonal reflection: B(i,j)=fg[hm-1-j][i] ... for square; generalize via transpose after flip
    def flip_v(m): return [r[:] for r in m[::-1]]
    B=[[flip_v(fg)[j][i] for i in range(len(fg))] for j in range(len(fg))]
    # place blocks: each block of the shape bbox filled with B color; assume block dims = shape/bbox ratio
    hr=r1-r0+1; wc=c1-c0+1
    br,bb=hr//max(1,len(fg)),wc//max(1,len(fg[0]))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(hr):
        for j in range(wc):
            out[i+r0][j+c0]=B[i//bb][j//br]
    return out
